title: River Point RV Park

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Whether you're passing through Eastern Oregon, visiting the Treasure Valley, or looking for a comfortable place to stay longer, River Point RV Park offers spacious full-hookup RV sites designed for convenience and comfort. Choose from a variety of site sizes ranging from 50 feet to more than 75 feet long, with water, sewer, and 20/30/50-amp electric service included. With easy access to I-84, modern amenities, and flexible stay options, River Point is an ideal choice for overnight travelers, weekly guests, and monthly residents alike. Whether you're stopping for a single night, staying for a week, or planning a longer visit, River Point RV Park offers accommodations to fit your travel

blurb: River Point RV Park is a modern RV park in Ontario, Oregon, conveniently located just off I-84 near the Idaho border and a short drive from Boise. Offering 179 spacious full-hookup RV sites, River Point welcomes overnight travelers, weekend visitors, extended-stay guests, and long-term residents alike.
